verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents several background automations that run without user action. Bill Pay "tracks due dates and executes your scheduled payments," bank reconciliation is set up as "automated workflows," and tracked time and expenses are added to invoices automatically. Webhooks with HMAC verification and a full REST API let users build their own event-driven automations externally. However, these are fixed built-in automations or require custom code, not a user-configurable automation system. Missing for 10: a native user-defined automation/rule builder, AI-agent-driven autonomous task execution, independent or hands-on corroboration of the background automations, and guaranteed webhook delivery timing (FreshBooks says it can take seconds to minutes).
